about.title: About
about.intro: I'm a full-stack developer with a strong IT foundation and a practical mindset. I focus on delivering clear, maintainable solutions with solid quality.
paragraphs: I completed the Full Stack Developer program (2023–2025), complementing the training with published real-world projects. In addition to this specialization, I bring technical knowledge in applying electronics to embedded systems, which helps me understand software through its direct interaction with hardware.
My path began in classic development environments, continuously evolving from structured and procedural programming paradigms toward modern, scalable, object-oriented architectures.
I enjoy working in teams where code is readable, security is taken seriously, and products deliver value. I value communication, discipline, and continuous improvement.

competencies: Low-level C programming and microcomputer architecture
